mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.product_code, p.description, p.price AS product_price, g.id AS goods_id, g.goods_name, g.sku, g.specification, g.stock, g.price AS goods_price FROM goods g LEFT JOIN product_goods pg ON g.id = pg.goods_id LEFT JOIN product p ON pg.product_id = p.id ORDER BY g.id, p.id

SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.product_code, p.description, p.price AS product_price, g.id AS goods_id, g.goods_name, g.sku, g.specification, g.stock, g.price AS goods_price FROM goods g LEFT JOIN product_goods pg ON g.id = pg.goods_id LEFT JOIN product p ON pg.product_id = p.id WHERE g.id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY p.id
